posts.raw_content:
Medias here is 100% government owned, government-funded and pure propaganda. All dissenting voices are silenced. Seriously, you should have seen it during COVID: truckers' protest was literally treated like absolute evil. "Oh no not inflatable pools!"

Anyway, as you may know, Trump decided not to make a deal with Canada. And people in Canada are acting like it's a good thing.

75% of our exports are to the US. A 50% tariffs in effect makes most of our "economy" (big word: Canada is mostly government jobs (40% of people?) and real estate) worthless.

And somehow the media act like it's not a big deal. Like Phoney Carmey somehow won by "retaliating" and adding tariffs on US products... yeah, really gonna help me at Costco, will it? 

You know how many fruits, textiles, technology and shit Canada produces? Not very many. Strawberries in summer, peaches sometimes, and Blackberries. Yeah.

So anyway, if you look at popular website (use AI to translate - lapresse.ca and journaldemontreal.com), it's 90% "news" about muh counter-tariffs, and by news, I mean propaganda. Fake experts going on saying "The biggest loser is Trump" (LOL) and "Carmey is a saviour" blah blah blah.

Fact is, many factories cannot withstand a 25% tariff, let alone a 50% one. Our car industry for instance, which is junk, will simply disappear. Americans won't buy an auto part in Canada witha 50% tariffs if they can buy it for 0% tariffs in the US.

Ever heard of C-series? Imagine that, but on a grand scale.

So anyway, I have to thank you. It's glorious watching the media meltdown.

One final thing: Canada could not afford half of its social programs if the US didn't finance them indirectly. Our free healthcare is LITERALLY because we have a cheap dollar and export so much to the US.

If tariffs hold, and I hope they do (or even go up, but there's no real point, they are high enough already), Canada's lumber, mining, textile, production and agricultural economy (grains mostly) is 100% fucked, period. 

Canada's economy is already trash (worst in developed nations). This is really gonna fuck up the boomers who destroyed this country (see: gun grabbing, no more freedom of speech online, backdoor in every device, and other tyrannical laws that passed just in the last year) and I'm glad those fuckers will suffer.
